entities.summary: Seven Church, a political institution in Türkiye during Classical and Roman Anatolia (133 BCE–395). Grew from Roman Empire and Alexander the Great cuts the Gordian Knot at Gordium. Led to the emergence of Constantine founds Constantinople — the 'New Rome'.
